scope: Finite implementation controls for the retained pilot. Semantic task gaps and native frontiers are accepted explicit outputs, not certified library guarantees.

checks.check: Legacy YAML/index/generation mutations leave the active corpus CLI unchanged; active writes require the coordinator.
Typed records, ordered declaration variants, exact bytes and unknowns survive Arrow/Lance and portable restoration.
Crashes at family, membership and manifest writes preserve the prior head and hide orphan rows.
Stale predecessors, mixed proposed membership and unauthorized output ownership are rejected.
Failed changed producers retire stale current outputs; interrupted pre-admission attempts remain failures.
Forged consequences, changed predicate values and dropped source qualifiers fail replay.
Rules, schemas, invocation mappings and witnesses require their separate approval authority; source citations alone grant none.
Unknown/conflicting evidence and unobserved objective values cannot become favorable facts or solver assignments.
Negation, modality, exceptions, symbolic defaults, source identity and native wrappers retain narrow facts or explicit uncertainty.
Representation/type/resource mismatches and unsupported invocation conditions are rejected or conditional; semantic eligibility has an explicit invocation limit.
Comparison populations are independent of retrieval rank; newly admitted competitors invalidate prior choices, including empty scoped populations.
Multi-input consumption, wrapper boundaries and unsupported transfer states remain explicit. The real schema composition rejects metadata loss and has compiler/execution witnesses.
Positive-support FCA preserves closure and unknowns; graphs retain isolates and labels cite actual source phrases without creating semantic authority.
Finite witnesses cannot rewrite observations or promote open effect frontiers; strictness and EOF counterexamples constrain stronger claims.

Exact selected input revisions, model changes, source replacement and new candidates invalidate dependents. Label completion preserves base extraction/embedding reuse. Field paths are declared, with conservative whole-record revision sensitivity.
Actual Qwen vectors, hybrid reasons and recipe reuse are retained; malformed responses, recipe mismatch and runtime outage have controls.

Native/analytical workers enforce declared process/output bounds; finite algorithms fail explicit limits. Record and nested candidate/proof pages retain denominators and pinned continuations without truncating stored evidence.

The final installed wheel verifies every selected portable archive with source trees, native workers, network, GPU service and model cache unavailable, including actual CLI pages and an installed analytical worker.
Pydantic and serde_json use the same frozen core and shared input pack, with zero per-operation prose overrides. All core and model corrections are reported and requalified.
All 24 retained tasks have same-agent attributed supported/partial/gap assessments, exact baseline selections and generated releases, reversing conditions and remaining interpretation.
Concrete record/field/byte support and independent closure replay are required; uncited composites and arbitrary IDs do not qualify behavior.
Real Rustdoc, Ruff, Pyrefly/TSP and MIR controls produce expected positive events and reject lookalikes; all 47 native jobs have explicit denominators.
Source identity does not elevate heuristic dispatch or native equivalence; impl polarity and cross-artifact identities retain distinct evidence.
Any/generic/native/indirect and unmodeled effects remain unresolved through typed projections and released analyses.
An enumerated body with open callees does not establish effect absence. Immediate async constructors and their later polled bodies are kept separate.
Unicode/CRLF, doctest hidden lines, prompts and escaped literals preserve exact maps; unmapped/generated ranges retain uncertainty.
Fragmented frames, truncation, wrong digests/schema/context, missing terminal receipts, hanging/closed-output children and RSS excess cannot admit success.
Effective package/feature/stub/compiler profiles are distinct. The retained Python 54/25 profile mapping is explicit and FFI availability is demonstrated in separate consumer builds.
Exact source/model prerequisites, uncited candidate changes and portable successors without original jobs reopen dependent products. Sensitivity is conservative at whole-record revision granularity.
Byte-only review equivalence is separate from contract mutation; source tampering, changed qualifiers and incomplete support cannot reuse an old qualification.
Actual native and analytical unchanged requests execute no producer. Corrupt receipts force execution or explicit failure; label work leaves base products warm.
Authored/generated scopes cannot shrink the independent policy or candidate population, including failed or newly added entries.
Under the target's explicit replacement authority, approved reusable rules plus replayed typed consequences qualify narrowly; arbitrary proposal import cannot approve itself.
The qualitative workflow uses zero automated model-judge runs or API keys; published decisions retain mechanisms, exact alternatives and explicit uncertainty.
The final wheel contains all 36 asset files; five owned native workspaces build/test/lint independently. Two unrelated libraries and offline installed reading use the same standalone package.

Real Cargo fixtures retain virtual/single package identity, duplicate versions, aliases, normal/dev/build dependencies, host proc macros, target kinds, required features and no-deps omission. Metadata explicitly does not claim unobserved compilation units.

All 21 ItemEnum and 14 Type wire variants survive 57/59/60/61 native admission and restoration with ordering and explicit historical metadata frontiers. Real private-origin aliases, wrappers, impl polarity and unknown externals retain their distinctions.

Exact source/helper/context digests distinguish acquisition requests. Documentation/private/hidden surfaces do not certify ordinary consumer availability; paired disabled/enabled FFI compiler results are separate.

Numeric ID/key-order changes preserve all 166 fixture contract digests. Bound/default/associated-requirement/impl-polarity/stability/mutability/public-route mutations remain observable; exact source prerequisites reopen sensitive qualifications. No blanket semver verdict or equivalence across unresolved Rust contexts is claimed.

Supported format decoding is strict, unknown formats fail, original native observations remain auditable and incomplete/budget-exceeded workers fail. Python receives owned per-record projections, never another whole raw Crate for semantic interpretation.
